title: Neon Spartan Oracle
description: A glowing white-line illustration of three armored Spartan warriors stands within a tilted rectangular frame against a black background. Red, pink, and yellow paint drips heavily from the top, while a stylized woman's face with glowing yellow eye and Medusa-like curly hair appears on the right. A green Celtic-patterned cat with red eyes walks at the bottom left, surrounded by floating green and yellow orbs.
prompt: A black background with heavy dripping magenta, red, and yellow paint from the top. Inside a tilted glowing rectangular frame, three Spartan warriors in detailed armor and helmets are drawn with clean white neon lines, one holding a spear and shield. To the right, a stylized woman's face with curly green snake-like hair and one glowing yellow eye. In the bottom left, a green Celtic knotwork cat with red eyes walks forward. Floating green and yellow orbs scattered around the composition in a surreal mythic style.
medium: Digital painting with spray paint effects
